test_conditions.HARD: p_blackout .05 dur 10-30, displacement always, K=4 (unseen in training)
test_conditions.LONG: 5 sequential picks, p_blackout .03 dur 5-20, displacement p=.5 per pick, K=2, no state reset

training.method: behaviour cloning from a noisy privileged scripted expert, identical data/steps/batch/lr for every arm
training.jepa: EMA(0.995) target encoder, stop-grad, cosine loss, weight 1.0, one-step predictor on h_t and a_t

arms.G: GRU + JEPA, FP16-costed (= Baselines B and D)
arms.G-Tu: ternary W QAT updater only (Candidate E1)
arms.G-Ta-s8: G-Ta with INT8 recurrent state (state-precision ablation)

eval.split_use: dev for all design/debug/calibration; test touched once, after this lock and after dev-based threshold calibration, for the reported numbers
eval.macro_success: mean over NOM, OCC, DIST, HARD
eval.ci: bootstrap over (seed, episode) pooled, 2000 draws, plus per-seed values reported

triggers: pix:tau (8x8 pooled pixel RMS change vs last encoded frame)
learned:tau (surprise head on h, a, 8x8 pooled frame)
adaptive.shared_forced_encode: first frame, task change, slip (held lost while gripper closed), >=8 steps since last encode
adaptive.calibration: tau chosen on DEV (NOM+DIST mix) to hit each target encoder fraction
adaptive.info_rule: gate may use only proprioception, the task code, the recurrent state and 8x8 pooled raw pixels; never the encoder embedding of the current frame, never privileged state

cost_metrics.analytical: MACs and weight+state bytes per control step, analysis/predictive_state/cost_model.py; ternary MAC counted as an add
cost_metrics.measured: batch-1 CPU per-step latency (p50/p95/max) of the PyTorch reference implementation, laptop on AC power; ternary has no packed kernel here, so measured latency cannot credit 2-bit weights

gates.G0_discrimination: On DEV: expert success >= 0.95 in every condition; and mean(G success on OCC,HARD) - max(R,S4 success on OCC,HARD) >= 0.15. Else STOP (benchmark does not establish a meaningful experiment).
gates.G1_floor: G (FP16 recurrent) test macro success >= 0.60 and NOM success >= 0.70 (mean over seeds).
gates.G2_ternary_retention: G-Tu and G-Ta each: test macro success >= 0.95 x G macro success (mean over seeds) with the lower 95% bootstrap bound of the ratio >= 0.90, and absolute macro >= 0.60.
gates.G3_adaptive: Learned-trigger model at the 0.33 budget (>=2x fewer encoder runs than full perception): macro success >= 0.95 x its own full-perception success, DIST success >= 0.90 x its full-perception DIST success, and success at matched budget >= both fixed-rate and pixel-difference controls by >= 0.03 (else the learned trigger is recorded as giving no advantage).
gates.G4_cost: Analytical (labelled ANALYTICAL): F-ternary vs the strongest suitable control = INT4-QAT recurrent (G-I4a or G-I4u, whichever is cheaper while retaining >=95% of G macro success) under the SAME trigger and budget: >=2x lower bytes per step AND >=2x lower MACs per step. Also reported vs FP16 full perception. Measured latency ratio reported separately; 'MEASURED PASS' requires measured p50 ratio >= 2x.
gates.G5_stability: LONG (5x training horizon, no state reset): G-T* picks_done fraction >= 0.95 x G; linear-probe R^2 of occluded target position (probe fit on steps <= 100 of dev rollouts, scored on steps > 300 of test rollouts) drops <= 0.05 vs G; no NaN and max|h| <= 1.0 by construction (tanh GRU) so also report mean |h| drift.
gates.G6_vs_best_conventional: Any advantage claim must hold against the best of {G-I8a, G-I4u, G-I4a} that retains >=95% of G macro success.

verdict_rules.STOP: G0 fails, or G1 fails after one documented fix attempt, or persistent state gives no benefit over R/S4 AND neither adaptivity nor ternary gates pass.
verdict_rules.CONTINUE: G1, G2, G3, G5 pass and G4 passes (analytical).
verdict_rules.NARROW: G1 passes and G2, G5 pass but only one of G3/G4 passes (name which).
verdict_rules.CHANGE_ARCHITECTURE: G1 passes and persistent state helps, but G2 or G5 fails (ternary unstable/lossy), or G4 fails against the INT4 control.

questions.A_persistent_state: G vs R/S4/T16 on OCC/HARD/DIST, and encoder reduction under G3.
questions.B_jepa: G vs G0 paired by seed: macro success and probe R^2; collapse monitored by embedding std.
questions.C_ternary: G vs G-I8a/G-I4*/G-T*; long-horizon stability (G5); state precision (G-Ta-s8).
questions.D_adaptive: G3 with triggers fixed-rate, pixel-diff, learned, for FP16 and ternary and INT4 models.

not_authorized: silicon, FPGA, RTL redesign, hardware purchases, paid cloud, physical robots, energy measurement
